UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user workspace profile and display preferences for Daylight.

uid.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this profile.

displayName.description: User display name shown in greetings and account settings.

theme.description: Preferred visual theme for the workspace.

streakRule.description: Rule used to calculate consistency streaks across calendar days.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

GoalItem.title: GoalItem
GoalItem.description: Individual daily goal item with independent completion and priority state.

id.description: Unique identifier for the goal within the day.

text.description: Goal description written by the user.

completed.description: Whether the goal has been checked off.

important.description: Optional priority marker for key daily intentions.

order.description: Zero-indexed sort position within the daily list.

createdAtMs.description: Client epoch milliseconds when the goal item was added.

DailyRecord.title: DailyRecord
DailyRecord.description: Date-scoped daily goals checklist, completion metrics, and reflection owned by a single user.

uid.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this daily record.

date.description: Local calendar date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

goals.description: Bounded list of up to 50 GoalItem maps for this calendar date.

totalGoals.description: Total number of goals recorded on this date (must match goals.size()).

completedGoals.description: Number of completed goals on this date (0 <= completedGoals <= totalGoals).

reflection.description: Optional daily reflection note for this calendar date.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily record was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user workspace document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/dailyRecords/{date}.description: Private date-scoped daily goals and reflection records keyed by YYYY-MM-DD.
